demand: A cryptographically signed evidence pack produced by an off-system key.
signature_instruction: Sign the canonical JSON of this file with an RSA key held OUTSIDE the audited repository and store <gate>.evidence.json.sig beside it, also outside the repository. Never commit the private key.
operator_note: Createlee produces the 8-file pack. The SIGNATURE must come from a key the audited system does not hold. Declare the public key to the release gate.
